title: INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of CEC postponed to Saturday due to rain
description:
INDIA bloc's "public impeachment" of Chief Election  Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar has been postponed to October 31 due to the rains here, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi said on Friday as the opposition asserted that the countdown to the exit of the poll body chief is accelerating.
The Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha reiterated that "this is not multiple protests" but "one protest", with the opposition standing together to defend the Constitution.
"By consensus we have decided to postpone today's programme to tomorrow because of rain. We felt that it would be uncomfortable for seniors to sit in the rain, and we would do the exact same programme tomorrow," Gandhi said at a joint press conference with INDIA bloc leaders outside Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge's 10, Rajaji Marg residence here.
Gandhi said on November 1, we have a "Chalo Dilli" march to Ramlila ground and  everyone who wishes to join is welcome, whether political or non-political.
